key_insight: Hilbert–Schmidt asymmetry can guide variational quantum optimization toward a target symmetry sector without requiring symmetry-preserving preparation circuits.
engineering_relevance: Symmetry-based guidance offers a way to improve VQE accuracy and reliability while retaining flexibility in circuit design.
method: Quantify deviations from symmetry using quantum-accessible Hilbert–Schmidt asymmetry.
Use the asymmetry objective to guide optimization toward collective SU(2) singlet states.
evidence_signal: Proof-of-principle tests on a five-qubit nuclear two-cluster Hamiltonian and collective spin models with up to 12 particles increased singlet probability and improved energy accuracy and ground-state fidelity, with substantial fidelity gains in larger spin systems.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish measurement overhead, noise robustness, or scalability beyond the tested systems.
paper_title: Symmetry-guided algorithms for variational quantum optimization
